subject: Need a rate on a Knoxville to Atlanta load
snippet: Floyd, we have a partial of brake assemblies headed to the Atlanta DC...
body:
Floyd,

We have a partial of brake assemblies headed to the Atlanta DC next week, about 4,200 lbs on two pallets. Looking to ship out Tuesday if we can.

Can you get me a rate and let me know which carrier you'd put on it? Appreciate you.

Glen

subject: Re: Need a rate on a Knoxville to Atlanta load
snippet: Glen, I can do that lane at $612 all in...
body:
Glen,

I can do that lane at $612 all in, picking up Tuesday morning. I'd put Ridgeline Trucking on it - they run that corridor daily and their on-time has been solid for us.

Say the word and I'll book it and get you a confirmation. Thanks Glen.

Floyd

subject: Re: Need a rate on a Knoxville to Atlanta load
snippet: That works. Book it...
body:
That works. Book it. Tuesday pickup is fine, dock opens at 7.

Send me the BOL when you have it.

Glen

subject: Re: Need a rate on a Knoxville to Atlanta load
snippet: Booked. Tracking 794612040001...
body:
Booked. Ridgeline is confirmed for Tuesday 7am pickup, tracking number 794612040001. BOL is attached.

I'll keep an eye on it and let you know the minute it delivers. Thanks for the load, Glen.

Floyd

subject: Ridgeline Trucking - insurance cert came back
snippet: Floyd, Ridgeline's COI updated, good through next March...
body:
Floyd,

Ridgeline Trucking's certificate of insurance came back today, good through next March. Cargo coverage is at $100k, auto liability $1M. Their MC authority is clean and safety rating is satisfactory.

I marked them approved in the carrier file for the automotive parts lanes. Anything else you want me to pull before we keep loading them?

Lorrie

subject: Re: Ridgeline Trucking - insurance cert came back
snippet: Good work. Pull their last six months of on-time...
body:
Good work, Lorrie.

Go ahead and pull their last six months of on-time numbers so I can have it for the carrier vetting refresh. I want clean records on every carrier we run for Cumberland and Tri-State before Q4.

Thanks.

Floyd

subject: Re: Ridgeline Trucking - insurance cert came back
snippet: On it. Should have the numbers to you Thursday...
body:
On it. I should have the on-time numbers pulled together by Thursday.

Ridgeline is running 96 percent on-time over the period, which is the best of the four carriers on that lane.

Lorrie

subject: TN Freight Association Annual Conference - Oct 10
snippet: Registration is open for the annual conference at the Volunteer Conference Center...
body:
Mr. Whitaker,

Registration is now open for the Tennessee Freight Association Annual Conference on October 10, 2026 at the Volunteer Conference Center in Knoxville.

As a member in good standing your early rate is $295 through August. This year's tracks cover carrier compliance, freight software, and the Southeast capacity outlook.

We hope to see you there.

TN Freight Association

subject: Re: TN Freight Association Annual Conference - Oct 10
snippet: Sign me up. Two registrations - myself and Brand Whitaker...
body:
Go ahead and sign me up. I'll need two registrations - myself and my associate Brandon Whitaker. He's new this year and I want him in the compliance and software sessions.

Put it on the card you have on file. Looking forward to it.

Floyd Whitaker, Whitaker Freight Services

subject: Re: TN Freight Association Annual Conference - Oct 10
snippet: You're both confirmed. Badges will be at will-call...
body:
You're both confirmed, Floyd. Two registrations at the member rate, receipt attached.

Badges will be at will-call the morning of. Don't forget the DOT compliance webinar on October 23 - it's included with your registration.

TN Freight Association

subject: Mentorship cohort - autumn
snippet: Floyd, I've got four young brokers lined up for the fall cohort...
body:
Floyd,

I've got four young brokers lined up for the fall mentorship cohort. Two from Knoxville, one out of Chattanooga, one in Nashville. All under three years in the business.

You still good to take the carrier relations and rate negotiation sessions? I'll handle the compliance side. Thinking we kick off mid September.

Keith

subject: Re: Mentorship cohort - autumn
snippet: Count me in. I'll take carrier relations and rates...
body:
Count me in, Keith. I'll take carrier relations and rate negotiation - that's where these young folks lose the most money early on.

Mid September works. Let's grab lunch at Oakwood Diner next week and lay out the schedule. I'll bring some real load examples to walk them through.

Floyd

subject: Re: Mentorship cohort - autumn
snippet: Oakwood Tuesday at noon?...
body:
Oakwood Tuesday at noon? I'll buy.

Real load examples are exactly what they need. Half these kids have never had to call a driver who's three hours late.

Keith

subject: Re: Mentorship cohort - autumn
snippet: Tuesday noon it is...
body: Tuesday noon it is. See you there.\n\nFloyd

subject: Quarterly review - October 2
snippet: Floyd, blocking October 2 for our quarterly...
body:
Floyd,

Let's block Friday October 2 for the quarterly review. I'd like to go over the Q3 numbers, your owner distributions, and get a jump on year-end tax planning.

Can you have Dale send me the P&L and the updated client receivables a week ahead? Makes the meeting go faster.

Wayne

subject: Re: Quarterly review - October 2
snippet: October 2 is on my calendar. Looping in Dale...
body:
October 2 is on my calendar, Wayne.

I'm copying Dale so he can get the P&L and receivables to you the week before. Revenue's been steady this year, tracking right around where we landed last year.

We can talk year-end planning and whether it makes sense to put more into the business reinvestment line. See you the 2nd.

Floyd

subject: Re: Quarterly review - October 2
snippet: Will have everything to you by September 25...
body:
Wayne,

I'll have the P&L and the updated receivables to you by September 25, a full week ahead.

Receivables are in good shape - only two accounts past 30 days and both are paying down. I'll flag those in the notes.

Dale

subject: Made it back to Nashville
snippet: Hey Daddy, got back to the dorm fine...
body:
Hey Daddy,

Got back to the dorm fine, traffic on I-40 wasn't too bad. Thanks for filling up the tank and for the cash.

Midterms start next week so I'll be buried in the law library. Tell Mama I'll call her Sunday. Love you.

Megan

subject: Re: Made it back to Nashville
snippet: Glad you made it. Study hard...
body:
Glad you made it back safe, sweetheart.

Study hard but don't run yourself down - get some sleep and eat right. Your Mama already misses you.

Call if you need anything, day or night. Proud of you. Love, Daddy

subject: Re: Made it back to Nashville
snippet: Will do. Tell Cody good luck at the scrimmage...
body:
Will do. Tell Cody good luck at his scrimmage Saturday. And save me some ribs at the cookout in October!

Love you both.

Megan

subject: Men's breakfast and the church van
snippet: Floyd, can you help with the church van logistics...
body:
Floyd,

We've got the men's breakfast a week from Saturday. Would you be willing to say the blessing and maybe share a few words about stewardship?

Also, the trustees want to move the old church van and I figured a freight man would know the cheapest way to get it to the buyer over in Maryville. Any wisdom appreciated.

Blessings, Pastor Harlan

subject: Re: Men's breakfast and the church van
snippet: Happy to say the blessing. Maryville's close...
body:
Pastor,

Happy to say the blessing and share a few words. Stewardship is something I can speak to honestly.

As for the van - Maryville's close enough you don't need a hauler. Just have someone with a good truck and a tow dolly run it over, or I can put you in touch with my brother Darrell if it needs trailering. No need to pay freight rates on a 20 mile haul.

See you Sunday. Floyd

subject: Poker Thursday + softball Saturday
snippet: Floyd, we still on for The Back Porch Thursday...
body:
Floyd,

We still on for The Back Porch Thursday night? Junior and Eddie are in. Eddie's threatening to win his money back.

Also softball Saturday at Lakeshore, 10am start. We're short a man at second base since Bill's knee gave out. You in for both?

Roy

subject: Re: Poker Thursday + softball Saturday
snippet: In for both. Tell Eddie to bring cash...
body:
In for both, Roy.

Tell Eddie to bring cash, not promises. I'll take second base Saturday - the back's been alright lately.

See you Thursday at The Back Porch. I'll bring some of the pulled pork from Sunday's smoke.

Floyd
